name: Undead Village (21.4N, 24.8W)
title: 21.4N, 24.8W - Undead Village
summary: A few Gharu'ndim houses full of lower undead at 21.4N 24.8W: a pitched-roof house, a 10 m stone house and an octagon tower. They stand with an ancient column, a well, a corpse and skeleton remains in a small forest clearing (z 2) near the coast. Undead and zombie generators are inside, and Humming Crystal portals stand 100-200 m south-west.

site.name: Undead Village (21.4N, 24.8W)
site.notes: Derived @teleloc in the village's clearing between the three houses (ground 2.0, 5.7 m from the column, 11 m from the nearest crown, 15 m from the octagon tower); the gazetteer's nearest outdoor entry is a Humming Crystal portal 215 m south-west.

shots.standingOrder: Look straight down on the undead village's three Gharu'ndim houses, column and well in their forest clearing and climb from 42 m to 90 m, rotating 40 degrees, until the coast opens to the south-west; stay 6 m above every crown.
shots.notes: Top-down rise. The camera looks straight down on the three Gharu'ndim houses, the column and the well in their forest clearing, and climbs from 42 m to 90 m, rotating 40 deg. The clearing shrinks into the forest and the coast opens to the south-west. It stays 8 m or more above the 36 m crowns.
